scope: Public synthetic OLD6144 critical constraint witness metadata and crop-path readiness only
selection: Per unchanged head and exact original group mask, retain every available row whose raw FP32 score equals the V170 bound: D189th-lowest among190; E13th-highest among16. Preserve all ties, deduplicate only by original input row identity while retaining every bound/head membership.
missing_or_untraceable: Preserve original witness; record UNKNOWN for absent row/crop/RGB lineage or path. Never substitute a better-looking example.
requested_lineage: GT group and original teacher semantics
original crop/RGB cache path and inherited seal SHA when present
bodies_allowed: V170 feasibility and bound input metadata, original public OLD6144 saved raw score packet, exact original public synthetic GT group masks, existing public synthetic cache producer code and metadata/seals only
bodies_not_opened: Original RGB, crop arrays, feature arrays, weights, current/V169/private/V112
interpretation: Critical score endpoints are feasibility witnesses, not selected thresholds or representative-success examples. Reference coordinate error, ray semantics and pixel-mask target differences may be read diagnostically; no GT recentering, q/L correction, new labels or fit.
